description: An opaque burgundy-brown and gold patterned court gown has a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a floor-length skirt with an ivory inset panel. Wide gold geometric embroidered borders run down the front and around the hem. A gold belt with round clasp defines the waist. An ivory shoulder wrap edged in gold rests around both forearms. Gold earrings, bracelets and a pendant necklace complete the dress, with one gold shoe visible below the hem.
